C2: Your Gantt chart and task descriptions show feasibility. For Accomplished, include explicit contingency provisions and a dedicated list of information sources, and align the Gantt with the text (background research overlap; editing weeks 9–10 vs review weeks 7–8).

C3: You completed STK tutorials 1–4 and background research, but no technical results are presented. To reach Accomplished, include preliminary simulation outputs (e.g., orbit/coverage) with brief interpretation, and correct the GEO altitude error (600 km is LEO; GEO ~35,786 km).

C4: Well-structured, readable, clear headings and labelled Gantt chart. For Accomplished, format references as proper citations (not URL-only), ensure in-text citations match the reference list, and tighten informal phrasing.
